iti47:2.1: jāgaro cassa bhikkhave bhikkhu vihareyya sato sampajāno samāhito pamudito vippasanno ca tattha kālavipassī ca kusalesu dhammesu.
iti47:2.2: jāgarassa bhikkhave bhikkhuno viharato satimato sampajānassa samāhitassa pamuditassa vippasannassa tattha kālavipassino kusalesu dhammesu dvinnaṃ phalānaṃ aññataraṃ phalaṃ pāṭikaṅkhaṃ
iti47:2.3: diṭṭheva dhamme aññā sati vā upādisese anāgāmitāti.
iti47:6.1: ayampi attho vutto bhagavatā iti me sutanti.
